note: Scans, queries and expected answers for python -m ground3d.bench. 'scan' is a scan folder written by python -m xray.scan. The first query of a case is the INIT target (its time counts toward INIT). Each case is one runner process (model load ~100 s), so put all the wordings for one scan in one case. Fill 'expect' from a run on the Jetson with --update-cases; per query (all optional): score (the same confidence band: high >= 0.5, low >= 0.3), band, min_score, center [x, y, z] in metres (within tol_cm, default 3).
